title: EvidenceRef (agent input contract)
description: Reference to a piece of claim evidence (multimodal) plus its audit-grade consent record. Closes the consent/evidence gap surfaced by the mvp-demo FNOL mobile contract and required by issues #80 (EvidenceRef) and #112 (evidence.opened). The agent receives only the ref + metadata, never raw PII payloads (constitution Art. X data minimization). Multimodal types align with sandbox spikes A1-A4 / D1.

type.description: Modality. photo/video/document/voice-transcript map to A2/A3/A4/A1 spikes.

uri.description: Pointer to the stored asset (blob/OneLake). Never inline content.

extraction.description: Structured extraction result + confidence (from the modality intake spike). Optional until the artifact is processed.

consent.description: First-class, audit-grade consent artifact (constitution Art. X; CA FCSPR). Required for any evidence that needs claimant authorization (dashcam, blackbox).

piiRedactionApplied.description: True if PII was masked before the agent sees derived data (Art. X).
